resources.string: 7. Text not showing?\n- Disable HMA (HideMyApplist) for Instagram. InstaEclipse reads its text from its own app, and HMA hides it.
8. Some features still won\'t work even when enabled?\n- Instagram\'s own config can block them. Use Developer Options → Restore Default Config.
9. Still stuck?\n- Ask in the Telegram group (t.me/instaEclipse_discussion).
